instruction.name: cpucfg
instruction.description: Read the CPUCFG word indexed by rj into rd.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 7.99; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: cpucfg $r12, $r4; cpucfg $r13, $r5; cpucfg $r14, $r6; cpucfg $r15, $r7; cpucfg $r16, $r8; cpucfg $r17, $r9; cpucfg $r18, $r10; cpucfg $r19, $r11
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 0; addi.d $r5, $r0, 0; addi.d $r6, $r0, 0; addi.d $r7, $r0, 0; addi.d $r8, $r0, 0; addi.d $r9, $r0, 0; addi.d $r10, $r0, 0; addi.d $r11, $r0, 0
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 0; addi.d $r5, $r0, 0; addi.d $r6, $r0, 0; addi.d $r7, $r0, 0; addi.d $r8, $r0, 0; addi.d $r9, $r0, 0; addi.d $r10, $r0, 0; addi.d $r11, $r0, 0' --asm 'cpucfg $r12, $r4; cpucfg $r13, $r5; cpucfg $r14, $r6; cpucfg $r15, $r7; cpucfg $r16, $r8; cpucfg $r17, $r9; cpucfg $r18, $r10; cpucfg $r19, $r11'
